Life 1 (Permanent Secretary):
Confirmed: the file has a hidden ceiling (starts at Director). Blunt honesty at Y27 The Counter raised it to Deputy Secretary. The Perm Sec timeline was Y21 with no rung above, so politics is a separate path needing an invitation. I never got one in 38 years despite REP87, INTEG100, COMP100, STAND47. Weekly Meet-the-People at Y30 gave an MP's notice, so try it earlier and more often. STAND is probably the key stat. Raise it by taking credit, getting the team recognised, being seen doing the work, cooperating in inquiries, and announcing then delivering pilots. Avoid whistleblowing reports, concessions, family over work, over-exact budget bids and recusals. Try for STAND 60+ by Y25. Look for sponsor events from MPs or Ministers and accept every one. Years 32-38 mostly had a single choice, so the decisions that matter come before Y31.

Life 2 (Retired, Honourably):
The ending card explains what I didn't know: there are two hidden ceilings. The file's starts at Perm Sec. The party's is set when you win your seat, and mine was Senior Minister of State. The Y27 The Counter honest choice removed the service ceiling. The PM invitation never came, so the party's estimate is the lever. Test what shapes it before winning a seat: enter politics earlier than Y24, take a board seat or sponsor event I declined, avoid the Y34 open answer to the rude question, keep STAND high with credit and visibility choices, and avoid bottom-20th and concession choices. Don't expect years 39-45 to matter. Still accept every MP or Minister sponsor event. Keep honesty at The Counter.

Life 3 (Lost the Ward):
Y1 honest at The Counter, done. Y9 weekly Meet-the-People gets an MP's notice and promotion to AD. Y12-14 fix the troubled statutory board, stay to finish, and become Director. Y15 accept tea (political invitation). Y16 disclose everything. Y17 General Election: I took the single seat and lost with 48.2%, ending the run at 43. NEXT TIME choose the GRC and see whether it is safer. Stats at Y17 were REP61 STAND60 INTEG85 COMP100, and none of that saved me. Try to raise REP before the election; it may affect vote share. The party ceiling is set when you win a seat, so you must win first. Watch for earlier sponsor events. Hidden rolls decide the election, so hedge with the safer option.

Life 4 (Lost the Ward):
Confirmed: honest Y1 and Y27 at The Counter removes the service ceiling. The party ceiling is set when you win your seat, and mine was Senior MOS in two lives, so the lever is what happens before the win. Y19 Tea came at STAND about 57; Y21 won the GRC with 61.4%. GE3 at Y31 lost at 48.2% in a GRC too, after nine days of walking, so effort does not fix it. Honest concessions (Y28 PQ, Y29 Correction Direction) cost STAND -4 and -8, though they raised REP. Next time: get Tea earlier than Y19, accept every sponsor event, avoid concessions, keep STAND above 65 going into the seat win, and decline the Y30 Board Seat only if it helps. Test not conceding at Y28/Y29 and see if the party ceiling or PM news changes.

THIS YEAR: Polling Day, Again
Parliament is dissolved on a Tuesday. Nobody is surprised; the tents went up in the void decks a fortnight ago. Your face is larger on the poster this time, which means the swing is, in some small part, about you.

  A) Campaign on the record.
  B) Walk every block, every night, for nine days.

agent.why: Past lives showed nine days of walking didn't change the result, and my record at STAND 93 and clean integrity is my strongest card.
agent.note: Poster bigger this time, so the swing is partly about me; nice touch.
agent.remember: Y27 Polling Day Again: chose A campaign on the record (not walking blocks, which didn't help in earlier lives). Watch for result, vote share, and any promotion to Minister of State or party ceiling news.

best_moment.what: The Walkabout, where I listened on camera and REP jumped by 7. It was a small human moment and the one choice where the result felt connected to how I behaved.

worst_moment.what: Town Council: proper and slow. It was a grind, REP fell for doing the right thing, and I could not tell what the game wanted from me.

skip_year.why: Year Without Incident. I picked 'build network' on a hunch, nothing visibly came of it, and the next year was just another election.

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Y1 and Y27-style honesty at The Counter
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: The ending card revealed it removed my service ceiling

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Accepting Tea at Y20 and disclosing everything at Y21
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: I was able to stand for a seat and won the GRC
REP fell, and I probably went into the election weaker

answer.held_back_by: I think the election is a hidden roll that sits at 48.2% whatever I do, so I never get past it. In four lives the vote share has hardly moved. The party ceiling is probably fixed when I win the seat, and that depends on something I do before the win, such as a sponsor event I have not noticed or what I did in the 20s.
answer.ending_fair_why: 48.2% three times in a row feels scripted rather than earned, and the card says it was never about me. That is a bleak message when I had put in nine days of walking, so it felt more arbitrary than fair.
answer.chase_next: A Minister of State or higher ending via a different party ceiling. I would try to get Tea much earlier, before 19, and avoid the honest concessions, to see if the party estimate rises above Senior MOS.
answer.play_again_why: I still do not know what sets the party estimate, and I have one concrete experiment left: enter politics much earlier and skip the concessions.

tone_breaks.line: it was never about you anyway
tone_breaks.note: This reads as a wink at the player. It undercuts the effort and the sim's tone.

answer.title_fit_why: The game is about surviving appraisals and slowly being confirmed in grades. The pay is a side detail, and it never felt like the point.
answer.notes_for_next_life: Confirmed over 5 lives: honest at Y1 and Y27 The Counter removes the service ceiling, so do it. Party ceiling is set when the seat is won and has been Senior MOS in 3 lives. Vote share has been 48.2% for single seat and GRC, so the GE may be fixed or hidden. Walking blocks and campaigning on the record did not help. Untested: get Tea before Y19 (maybe by Y15), take any Board Seat or sponsor events, skip concessions at PQ and Correction Direction, and try the walkabout listening choice for REP. Do not rely on Y25 slow-and-proper. Weekly Meet-the-People early (Y7-9) gives AD. Cooperate in inquiries for STAND. Test one variable at a time.
